title: Insurance Desk Questions and Answers: The Amount Collateral Protection Insures on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Loan
content:
**Rule.** The amount collateral protection insures on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan depends on the loan's position on the placement date: when the principal balance is above the pledged value of the units still securing the loan, the coverage insures that pledged value; when the principal balance is not above it and billed interest remains unpaid on the loan, the coverage insures the principal balance plus that billed interest not yet paid; otherwise it insures the principal balance. The premium is figured on the amount insured.

**What is the pledged value of the units still securing the loan?**
The pledged value of every unit pledged to the loan less the pledged value of every unit since released, as the loan's collateral record shows on the placement date.

**What is billed interest not yet paid?**
The interest billed with the loan's installments, less the interest payments applied, with any interest payment the member's bank returned added back, rounded to cents.

**Which amount is insured?**

| Principal balance against the pledged value still securing the loan | Billed interest not yet paid | Amount insured |
|---|---|---|
| above it | any | the pledged value still securing the loan |
| not above it (equal or below) | some remains | the principal balance plus the billed interest not yet paid |
| not above it (equal or below) | none | the principal balance |

**What happens when the principal equals the pledged value exactly?**
The principal is then not above the pledged value, so the second or third row applies according to the billed interest.

**Hypothetical figures.** Principal 52000.00 with units still pledged at 47500.00: 47500.00 is insured. Principal 40000.00 with units at 47500.00 and 612.40 of billed interest unpaid: 40612.40 is insured. Principal 40000.00, units at 47500.00, no billed interest unpaid: 40000.00 is insured.
